lumina_extras.notes: DPS expansion. +20% Gradient Charge on Critical Hit, once per turn. Fires every turn at 109% crit.

lumina_extras.notes: DPS expansion. 5% increased damage per consecutive dodge, stacks to 10. Parry does not reset the stack.
